source.seed_note: Pilot-scale seed for Phase R2 (content/bootstrap). Anchors are confirmed by two independent sources: string-literal match ('MAS' in raw C, tools/f1c_mod.py search) AND a reviewed name in tools/sdk/f1c_sdk.json (MAS_Close_Wrapper, PITANIMS_MAS_Animation_File_Loader, Pit_Crew_Animation_MAS_Setup). Expansion is deterministic address-sorted BFS over analysis/recovery_index.json caller/callee edges, capped at 300 functions for pilot scope. This is not a claim of full content/bootstrap coverage -- legacy path precedence and content registration proper still need their own anchors before a non-pilot R2 slice.
